# The conformance fixtures — sizes, hashes, and what each is for

**Generated by `fixtures/record_fixtures.py`. Do not hand-edit.**
Re-run it after any fixture rebuild; `--check` is what a gate runs.

This file exists because the same fixture name denoted different
bytes in different sections of `HANDOVER.md`, and only one section
said so (findings S8-1 … S8-5). A number transcribed into prose in
several places is a number whose copies cannot disagree loudly. The
numbers now live in `fixtures/fixtures.json`, this table is rendered
from it, and every gate harness pins the fixture it measures against
it through `tests/fixture_pin.py` — so a rebuild fails a gate with
the old and the new hash in the message instead of quietly changing
what the gate measured.

**Zip entries and declared files are different counts and are named
differently on purpose.** They differ by exactly two: `MANIFEST.json`
and `SIGNATURE.json` are container entries and are deliberately in no
node's `files[]`, because the manifest hashes every file it lists and
the signature signs the manifest (SPEC §2, D-MAN-1). Calling entries
"files" makes that off-by-two read as a bug in the rule (S8-5).

## What each one is for, and what builds it

### `fixtures/crate-v1.werk`

The golden sample: profile 3d-entity/1, built from a real splat-foley run. A complete audio family, no custom binaries, vertex-coloured so it has no core.tex.

* built by `fixtures/build_golden.py`
* manifest sha256 `5b4a7bcb7086dd8508339f43a812ced86ee2aa3934554bb2cf3e6abebb474271`
* `spec_sha256` `12b0e574e00e6d5fc78625ee750ae8517058ace68481cdfd3e26917b4d3e600a`

### `fixtures/crate-cc0-lean-v1-deflated.werk`

The ONLY fixture whose zip entries are DEFLATED (method 8): the lean CC0 crate's content, byte for byte, compressed by zlib, so that the four reference readers' inflate is tested against streams none of them wrote (ruling 9 of 2026-10-13). Its bytes depend on the zlib version that built it.

* built by `fixtures/build_deflated_fixture.py`
* manifest sha256 `08a7633b3ffbf25d6fa95c630f524339d963520f6fb675142cd94d97b0011091`
* `spec_sha256` `12b0e574e00e6d5fc78625ee750ae8517058ace68481cdfd3e26917b4d3e600a`

Every fixture in this table carries the same `spec_sha256`, which is
the point of the field (S-29): they were all built from one revision
of `spec/`, and a package built from another one says so in a single
comparison rather than by a schema diff nobody runs.
